name: Natsu Yume Kanata
source:
Having been depressed due to the death of his father, Asakawa Keiichi, a "genius elementary school student," one day meets a girl dressed as a shrine maiden who claims to be a god.
Through his interactions with the girl, Keiichi remembers his dream of becoming a professional shogi player.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/15681]Freem![/url]]
